notes: Original interpretive MBTA-style vehicles. Green-E separate directed OSM tracks with MBTA station names/positions; surface only, ending at the portal north of Northeastern. Buses follow the typical MBTA pattern of each listed route in both directions, clipped to the playable coverage (coveragePercent records how much of the source shape is kept); destination signs show the MBTA headsign. Operating speed, dwell, traffic behavior and frequency are game assumptions; no real-time service or timetable.
